purpose: Validate the integrity, freshness, cross-stage consistency, and provenance of the verified Stage 5-9 candidate pipeline without producing a trading decision.

inputs.stage6_regimes: Stage 6 PSY29 Live Regime Engine V2 output
inputs.stage7_activation: Stage 7 PSY29 Research-Conditioned Edge Activation output
inputs.stage8_ranking: Stage 8 PSY29 Portfolio Edge Ranking output
inputs.stage9_quality: Stage 9 PSY29 Candidate Quality Confidence output

research_profile_integrity: Exactly one Stage 5 profile per canonical symbol.
live_data_integrity: FRESH is accepted as live-valid; DATA_STALE remains DATA_STALE.
edge_state_integrity: Activation state is one of EDGE_ACTIVE, EDGE_INACTIVE, DATA_STALE, DATA_INVALID.
ranking_integrity: Only EDGE_ACTIVE rows have ranking values.
Ranking score is finite and within 0-1.
quality_integrity: Only EDGE_ACTIVE rows have candidate quality values.
Candidate quality is finite and within 0-100.
Quality score is not a probability.
cross_stage_consistency: Symbol sets and row coverage agree across Stages 5-9.
Stage 6 regime/data status agrees with Stages 8-9.
provenance_integrity: Stage 5 source is the locked profile file.
Stages 6-9 source labels are present and internally consistent.

decision_rule: INTEGRITY_PASS means the row's prerequisite data and provenance are internally consistent. INTEGRITY_FAIL means live data is valid/fresh but a non-fatal integrity prerequisite fails. DATA_STALE preserves stale live data. DATA_INVALID is fail-closed for missing, malformed, contradictory, or unverifiable data.
fail_closed_rules: Any missing or duplicate canonical symbol invalidates the run.
DATA_STALE and DATA_INVALID can never become INTEGRITY_PASS.
No trading decision or execution instruction is emitted.
Historical research evidence remains behavioural evidence only.
